candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment that overwrites the balance with msg.value instead of adding to it.
Replace add_uint256 with sub_uint256 so deposits subtract from the balance instead of adding.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer records an entry in the Log's History.
Delete the statement resetting locked_ to false after the function body so the lock is never released, causing any subsequent Put/Collect call to revert.
Remove the balance-decrement statement so Collect never reduces the caller's stored balance.
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful Collect operations are never logged.
Drop the nonReentrant_ modifier from Collect, allowing reentrancy during the external call.
Remove the statement that resets locked_ to false, permanently locking all guarded functions after the first invocation.
